title: Acquire and pay the numerical geometry
statement: Start from the actual seed and pool of current landmarks plus one-step successors;measure their Gram matrix through real return experiments. Exact finite confidence certificates admit only physically independent new landmarks. No rank,useful basis,Gram floor or latent transitions are supplied. Acquired G,K_a,D_aand rational Rpay ||R^T Ghat R-I||<=nu,z>=eta||R||²,t=nu+z<=1/2. The empirical norm-based Schur residual,with its perturbation/conditioning factors,certifies squared physical leakage;stored operators are qualified contractions. Corrected valid spectral-norm bisection and coefficient/bit-length qualifications remain. The separately reviewed conversion of an ALREADYacquired l1dictionary uses at most rEuclidean runtime coordinates at task resolution without normalizing every weak direction;it does not remove old exponential discovery cost. Ordinary spectral/predictive-state machinery is adopted and credited.
